Hi Chloe,

Hope you're well — we found a discrepancy on Redwood invoice INV-5567 (June). Our finance team saw two sets of usage rows that look duplicated for the period Jun 1–15 (same model + identical token counts). That doubled the billed tokens for those days and bumped our total by ~14%. We've attached a CSV export from our side showing the duplicate lines (usage-export-20260630.csv).

We need: 
- a short reconciliation explaining why the duplicate rows appeared,
- a corrected invoice or credit note for the overbilled amount, and
- a pause on any collection activity on INV-5567 while we reconcile (AP has tried to submit payment but we've held it).

Can you route this to finance and confirm next steps? We can be available for a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Finance Operations
BlueRiver Analytics

Samantha — thanks for flagging and for the CSV. I’ve looped in Logan (Revenue Ops) and Marissa (Billing) to investigate.

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mismatch on June invoice / request to pause collections

Forwarding my initial review — see quoted message below. Summary of what I found in the ingestion logs: there was a brief retry loop between our aggregator and the billing exporter on 2026-06-07 03:14–03:18 UTC that caused the exporter to emit two identical usage batches for a subset of customers. BlueRiver was in that subset.

Impact estimate: ~13.7% of June token charges are duplicated in the current invoice total.

Proposed remediation steps (for Marissa & Chloe):
1) Issue a credit note CR-783 for the duplicate lines (amount matches the duplicated tokens).
2) Reissue an amended invoice INV-5567A showing the credit and net due.
3) Reverse any collection flags and confirm AP can now submit payment against the amended invoice.

I’ve attached the export we used to calculate the duplicate volume and a short internal postmortem (internal only).

Logan Wright
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Vendor statement (for BlueRiver Analytics records):

- Impact: The duplicated batches caused duplicate line items in the Jun 1–15 usage export, resulting in an approximate 13.7% overbilling on the June invoice (INV-5567).
